# Contributing to MCP JSON Schema

I really appreciate your interest in MPC JSON Schema. Please feel free to [file bug reports and enhancement requests](https://github.com/sualeh/mcp-json-schema/issues), and I will do my best to address them quickly.

If you would like to make a contribution, please sign the Contributor Agreement first. Please read ".github/CLA.md" carefully, and put your name in the table at the bottom as a signatory. Please commit this change as a verified commit, and submit a pull request.

Thank you.

[Sualeh Fatehi](https://sualeh.github.io/)
